content.title: Buy a Tech, or Buy a Story? The Digital Innovation–Transformation Divide in Tech M&A
content.abstract: While technology acquisitions by non-technology firms are prevalent, seemingly similar transactions often yield heterogeneous market reactions. The theoretical distinction between digital innovation (DI) and digital transformation (DT) provides a framework to organize this heterogeneity, yet a tractable, deal-level empirical proxy has remained elusive. We argue that the digital orientation of a technology acquisition is substantiated throughout the integration period.
